subject: prd/local-work-tracker
statement: When asked to show a work item by id, the tracker shall return all of its fields — type, state, title, body, signals, assignees, parent, dependency edges, comments, and decision records.
rationale: the item is the read surface for humans and the engine
fit_criterion: every field written in FR-1/3/5/6/7/8/9 round-trips through show
